events.verdict: Bey (NOP) releases away from Powell (BKN) as they separate following the pick.
Clowney (BKN) jumps alongside Bey's (NOP) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Claxton (BKN) grazes Murphy III's (NOP) arm as he defends the shot attempt, and the contact is marginal.
Missi (NOP) places his hand momentarily on Claxton's (BKN) hip as he moves to set the pick.
Fears (NOP) and Demin (BKN) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Clowney (BKN) dislodges the ball from Williamson (NOP).
Clowney (BKN) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Pelicans.
Missi (NOP) legally contests Demin's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Demin (BKN) directly contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Murphy III's hand after the release.
Williamson (NOP) deflects the ball away from Powell (BKN), and the ensuing body contact is marginal.
Williamson (NOP) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nets.
Bey (NOP) does not extend his arms into Clowney (BKN) as he separates to switch onto Powell (BKN.
Williamson (NOP) and Clowney (NOP) come together at the same spot, and incidental foot to foot contact occurs on the perimeter.
Missi (NOP) legally contests Porter Jr.'s (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Claxton (BKN) and Demin (BKN) both make contact with the ball and dislodge it from Matkovic (NOP) during the rebound.

Replay review of the foul called on Claxton (BKN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Claxton extends his hands into Murphy III (NOP) and delivers contact that affects his SQBR.  During the replay review, it was also confirmed Murphy III did not step out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Claxton (BKN) commits a take foul on Bey (NOP).
Murphy III (NOP) deflects the ball away from Claxton (BKN).
